notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (no business-type funds). The printed Exhibit D General Fund total receipts reads 17,085,134 but the General Fund lines and Exhibit F total are 17,065,134; the Total column ties to 17,065,134 (see report_discrepancies). Local Sources split by the fund schedules (Exhibits F, H, I, J, K, L): property tax, penalties & interest, carline, PPD sales tax, motor vehicle, tuition, lunch sales, activity (extracurricular) receipts, fines and licenses, interest, donations, other. Attempt 3 (verifier fix 2026-10-28): the Local Sources lunch-sales split (1611 Lunchroom Sales 272,112, p8) is category School Lunch Sales, matching the detail line. Transfers in/out: 535,000 (General Fund to Activities 200,000 and Depreciation 335,000). General Fund detail is function-level only (Exhibit F); no program-by-object exhibit in the trimmed PDF. Employee Benefit fund budgeted a 100,000 transfer in but actual was none. Exhibit F lines with zero actual (1410, 2210, 2650, 5301, 9000) omitted. Debt Service line split into principal 915,000 and interest 299,885 using fund schedules; the other debt-related fees 600 and 950 are in the statement's Operation/Maintenance and Central Services lines.
